data.name: Paws & Circuits: Reboot Earth
data.detailed_description:
Explovival – not just another survival

Paws & Circuits is a cozy eco-survival game about a wounded raccoon, his drone buddy, and a trash-covered 4×4 km island. Clean up human leftovers, recycle resources, and gather seasonal plants to survive changing weather and four distinct seasons – without loot grind or stress survival.

Live with the seasons, not against them.

Food doesn’t just respawn – it follows the year:

  • Strawberries start as blossoms in spring and only turn into juicy fruit in summer.

  • Carrots grow through summer and can be pulled from the ground in autumn and early winter.

  • Other plants, mushrooms, herbs and berries have their own short seasons – miss the window, miss the meal.

Play by senses, not by bars

You don’t stare at HUD bars – you play by what you see and hear:

  • Your stomach growls when you’re hungry.

  • Your movement gets heavy when you’re injured.

  • You slow down and start looking for water when you’re thirsty.

When you need exact numbers, you call your drone. It brings up a HUD on demand – when you’re done, the UI fades and the world fills the screen again.

Core Features

  • New sub-genre “Explovival” – focused, cozy survival without loot and dopamine spam.

  • Buddy drone with a smart task system: scan, mark, clean up, and carry trash.

  • Cleaning trash = visible island progress – the more you recycle, the more the island changes.

  • Weather, time of day, and four seasons with seasonal plants and food.

  • Hand-crafted 4×4 km island: beach, forest, volcano, dynamic weather.

  • Minimalist UI – HUD only appears when you call your drone.

  • Optional hardcore mode (1 in-game day ≈ 24 minutes, permadeath, gravestone save, later leaderboard).

  • Singleplayer first; co-op planned depending on community feedback.

  • Early-supporter bonus: playable red panda variant.

data.short_description: A cozy explovival game where you play a wounded raccoon and his helper drone, cleaning a polluted 4×4 km island, recycling trash, gathering plants and surviving weather, seasons and hunger while slowly rebooting nature.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6 GB / RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD, 1080p/High Settings
